definition: An Aspen PIMS planning model that optimizes a refinery plan across several periods, carrying inventory from one period to the next. Aspen PIMS is AspenTech's refinery and olefins linear programming (LP) planning software, by the vendor's description.

An MPC-built optimization model and application that produces the distribution plan for the prompt month to M+3, across pipelines, marine and inventory. Planners build a base distribution plan in it, reconcile it with the XPIMS refinery plan, update its network constraints, and hand over the final distribution plan. It is also used in the distribution backcast, to evaluate actuals cases and optimization cases.

An MPC in-house application used by the Commercial organization. It gets all of its data from RightAngle and is almost a replica of it.

ION's commodities trading and risk management system for liquid hydrocarbon companies, such as refiners and fuel marketers. By the vendor's description, it covers the work from front to back and is strongest in scheduling, logistics and operations.
Profisee's master data management (MDM) platform. By the vendor's description, it cleans, unifies and improves the quality of an enterprise's critical data across its systems.
SAP's business suite. By the vendor's description, it is the next-generation business suite, built on the SAP HANA in-memory platform.
note: The process map's "SAP" is SAP S/4HANA by the decision owner's answer of 2026-10-25. Which edition MPC runs is not stated in the repository, so the definition is at product level (EPM-DEC-001-0099).
